caption: A single translucent, glossy rounded-square block, pale pinkish-white in tone, is centered above a thin horizontal support line against a smooth dark-blue gradient backdrop. Its left-center face carries a wet-looking speckled highlight patch that subtly shifts in shape and brightness over time. Near the lower edge, a thin dark crack is already present and gradually extends toward the right, growing from a short stub into a longer line. The block’s outline changes only slightly, broadening along the sides and rising at the top, while no clear rotation is visible. The background gradient and support line appear broadly stable, while the block’s apparent position and surface shift subtly. The cracking and surface shifts continue throughout.
